D: Peter Parker balances high school in Queens with trying to prove himself as Spider-Man.
P: Serve the mains when Peter orders his sandwich at Delmar's.
S: the academic decathlon trip to Washington

Popcorn coated in a crackly brown sugar and butter caramel with sea salt, tossed with pretzels and peanuts, packed in paper bags for the bus. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Melt 100g butter with 200g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup and boil 4 minutes, then take off the heat and stir in 1/2 tsp bicarb soda and 1 tsp salt. Pour over the popcorn, 100g pretzels and 100g peanuts, and stir to coat. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool and break up.
Cauliflower florets baked in light batter, tossed in buttery hot sauce and served with blue cheese dip.
M: Peter's order at Delmar's deli, pressed flat
Long rolls filled with salami, ham, provolone, pickles and mustard, pressed hard in a sandwich press until flat and crisp.
Staten Island Ferry chicken parm heroes
Peter trying to hold the split Staten Island Ferry together

Crumbed chicken schnitzels fried crisp, baked under tomato sauce and melted mozzarella, stuffed into long toasted rolls with basil. Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound thin. Coat in flour, beaten egg and 150g panko mixed with 30g parmesan. Shallow fry in oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Lay on a tray, spoon over 250ml passata cooked with garlic and oregano, top with 200g grated mozzarella and grill until bubbling. Tuck into 4 toasted long rolls with basil leaves.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled and piped with swirls of red and blue buttercream, with a little web drawn in white icing.
K: study session snacks with Ned and MJ

Sweet brown sugar milk tea poured over chewy tapioca pearls and plenty of ice, shaken frothy and served with fat straws. Cook 150g tapioca pearls as the pack says, drain and soak in a syrup of 4 tbsp brown sugar and 3 tbsp hot water. Brew 4 strong black tea bags in 600ml boiling water for 5 minutes, then chill. Spoon the pearls and syrup into 4 tall glasses and add ice. Shake the tea with 400ml cold milk and 2 tbsp sugar until frothy and pour over. Serve with fat straws.

Cut 1 cauliflower into florets. Toss in a batter of 3/4 cup flour, 180ml water and 1 tsp garlic powder and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Toss in 80ml hot sauce mixed with 30g melted butter, bake 10 minutes more and serve with blue cheese dressing.

m.note: Peter's order at Delmar's deli, pressed flat
m.how: Split 4 long bread rolls and spread with yellow mustard. Layer with salami, ham, provolone and sliced dill pickles. Press hard in a sandwich press or a heavy pan with a weight on top until flat, crisp and the cheese has melted. Cut in half to serve.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Pipe swirls of red and blue buttercream on top, then draw a little white icing web over each.
